name: SAM.gov
description: US federal procurement notice search and detail, including agency, deadlines, attachments and amendment history.

tools.name: Detail
tools.description: Fetch one SAM.gov contract opportunity by its 32-character notice id (the id in https://sam.gov/opp/{id}/view): full description, deadlines, NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, points of contact, award data, attachments (titles and download URLs only) and optionally the amendment history.

options.name: fresh
options.about: Always true in practice: every call goes to SAM.gov live with a cache-busting parameter; the workflow keeps no cache.

options.name: include_attachments
options.about: List attachments (title, download URL, size, type). Contents are never fetched.

options.name: include_history
options.about: Include the version history (original notice and every amendment) as record.history.

options.name: opportunity_id
options.about: SAM.gov notice id. Each published version (original or amendment) has its own id; is_latest/latest_opportunity_id in the record point at the current version. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$.

response.about: Fetch one SAM.gov contract opportunity by its 32-character notice id (the id in https://sam.gov/opp/{id}/view): full description, deadlines, NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, points of contact, award data, attachments (titles and download URLs only) and optionally the amendment history.

fields.name: agency
fields.about: Top-level department (hierarchy level 1).

fields.name: archive
fields.about: When SAM.gov will/did archive the notice (auto15 = 15 days after the deadline, autocustom = the given date, manual).

fields.name: attachments_retrieved
fields.about: false means the attachment list was not requested; an empty list with true means the notice has none.

fields.name: classification_code
fields.about: Product/service code (PSC).

fields.name: description
fields.about: Plain text (HTML stripped). An excerpt on summary records.

fields.name: history
fields.about: Only with detail include_history=true; newest version first.

fields.name: is_archived
fields.about: null on summary records (the search index does not expose it).

fields.name: is_latest
fields.about: false when a newer amendment supersedes this version; see latest_opportunity_id.

fields.name: naics_codes
fields.about: Empty on summary records (see detail_level) or when the notice lists none.

fields.name: notice_type_code
fields.about: SAM.gov single-letter code (p,o,k,a,r,s,i,g,u,f,l).

fields.name: office
fields.about: Deepest contracting office in the hierarchy.

fields.name: opportunity_id
fields.about: SAM.gov notice id; stable for this published version. Amendments publish a new id whose parent_opportunity_id is the original.

fields.name: parent_opportunity_id
fields.about: Original notice id when this record is an amendment.

fields.name: published_at
fields.about: When this version was published (UTC).

fields.name: response_deadline
fields.about: Response due date-time in UTC. null when the notice has none (awards, many special notices) - not a zero or an empty string.

fields.name: response_deadline_date
fields.about: Calendar date of the deadline in the notice's own timezone (the date shown on the SAM.gov page).

fields.name: response_deadline_local
fields.about: The deadline exactly as SAM.gov stores it, with its own offset.

fields.name: set_aside
fields.about: SAM.gov set-aside code, null when none.

fields.name: source_status
fields.about: Raw source state: search index gives active|inactive[,canceled]; the notice API gives its status code (published) plus ,archived / ,cancelled flags.

fields.name: status
fields.about: Normalized: cancelled if the notice was cancelled; open while SAM.gov lists it active/not archived (even past the deadline until the archive date); closed once inactive/archived.

records.description:
Combined Synopsis/Solicitation

AFLCMC/PZI Installation Contracting Support

Wright Patterson AFB, OH 45433

Date: 2 SEP 2026

Title: AFIT HVAC CLEANING

Request for Quote (RFQ) / Solicitation Number: FA8601-26-Q-0141

Quotes Due: 15 SEP 2026 at 12:00 PM EST

Contact Point(s): TSgt Adam Holden, Contract Specialist; contact@example.gov

Contact Point(s): Jessica Stamper, Contracting Officer; contact@example.gov

Description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued.

Solicitation number FA8601-26-Q-0141 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for AFIT HVAC CLEANING at Wright Patterson Air Force Base as described under the requirements section of this combined synopsis/solicitation and accompanying requirements attachment.

This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns under NAICS code 561790 - Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings with a small business size of $9.0M. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov.

The Government reserves the right to conduct interchanges with some, none, or all offerors, or make no award at all depending upon: An award, if any, will be made LPTA. Ie, to the lowest priced Offeror who submits a proposal that:

Conforms to the requirements of the combined synopsis/solicitation.

Receives a rating of “Acceptable” on the Technical Capability evaluation factor.

Contains the lowest evaluated price (TEP), provided that the TEP is not unbalanced and is fair and reasonable.

***NOTE: The Government is recommending that all bidding vendors attend a site visit for Wednesday September 9, 2026 10:00EST at the following address:

4185 Logistics Ave,

Bldg 286 Area A,

Wright Patterson Air Force Base

To obtain access to the installation vendors will need to acquire a visitor’s pass. Attendees must register in advance by emailing Joel Wilson at contact@example.gov and Mark Rauch at contact@example.gov, no later than 10:00AM. EST on Tuesday Sep 8, 2026, with the following information:

​​​​

Visitor’s full name and cell phone number

Preferred email address

Driver’s license number and state of issuance

The vendor will be required to pick-up their visitor’s pass at Pass and Registration located in Area A, Bldg 286, 4185 Logistics Ave, Dayton, OH 45433. Once base access has been granted, please wait in the lobby for Joel Wilson to escort you to the site visit location.

The Government also reserves the right to cancel this solicitation, either before or after the closing date.

1. Requirement:

This requirement is for AFIT HVAC CLEANING at Wright Patterson Air Force Base in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS).

2. Period of Performance:

No later than 90 Days after contract award. This is inclusive of in person post award site visit, material finish selection, furniture lead time and installation.

3. Provisions and Clauses:

See solicitation attachment for applicable provisions and clauses that apply to this acquisition. Offerors shall complete and include in quotations all representations and certifications, as well as all fill-in provisions and clauses, contained within this solicitation. Additionally, quotations that contain pricing only with no description/detail of the equipment that will be provided will not be accepted or considered for award. NOTE: In accordance with deviation R-DFARS 252.204-7998(g), the offeror's quote submission legally binds and certifies that its SAM registration is current, complete, accurate, and has been updated within the preceding 12 months as of the offer's date.

Mandatory Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 1 Assessment:

In accordance with DFARS 252.204-7021 and DFARS 252.204-7025, a CMMC Level 1 assessment is a mandatory requirement for all offerors. To be eligible for contract award, offerors must demonstrate full compliance with the 15 basic safeguarding requirements outlined in FAR 52.240.93.

4. Request for Information (RFIs):

The Government will accept questions concerning this solicitation until 14 Sep 2026 at 12:00 PM EST. Email your questions on a .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xls or .xlsx document to contact@example.gov and contact@example.gov. Any questions received after this date and time may not be considered.

5. Quotes Due Date:

Quotes must be submitted electronically to the Contract Specialist via e-mail at contact@example.gov and Contracting Officer at contact@example.gov. Quotes must include all applicable shipping costs to include insurance. Quotes must conform to the requirements of this solicitation and be received no later than 15 SEP 2026 at 12:00 PM EST. It is the responsibility of the offeror to ensure that the quote and its attachments are received. Any correspondence sent via e-mail must contain the subject line “FA8601-26-Q-0141 - AFIT HVAC CLEANING” The entire quotation must be contained in a single e-mail that does not exceed 5 megabytes including attachments, if any. E-mails with compressed files are not permitted. Note that e-mail filters at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base are designed to filter e-mails without subject lines or with suspicious subject lines or contents (i.e., .exe or .zip files). Therefore, if the specified subject line is not included, the e-mail may not get through the e-mail filters. Also be advised that .zip or .exe files are not allowable attachments and may be deleted by the email filters at Wright-Patterson. If sending attachments with email, ensure only .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xls or .xlsx documents are sent. The email filter may delete any other form of attachments. If a DoDSafe drop off is needed, please notify the contract specialist or contracting officer at least 48 hours before quotes are due. Any quotes received after designated closing date and time need not be considered. Quotes must include aggregate total of base plus all option year CLINS, if requested (IAW RFO 52.217-5 Evaluation of Options). All quotes shall be in whole dollars and conform to the Contract Line-Item Number (CLIN) structure of attached solicitation.

6. Notice to Vendor(s):

All vendors must fully complete and return the 'Required Information Sheet' (attached to the solicitation) and return with their quotation. Additionally, quotations that contain pricing only with no description/detail of the supply/service that will be provided will not be accepted or considered for award.

7. Period of Acceptance of Quotes:

Offeror agrees to hold prices in its quote firm for 60 calendar days from the date specified for receipt of offers.

8. SAM Registration:

Firms submitting a quote for the solicitation described herein, MUST be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database, or risk the quote as being non-responsive, regardless of the package being considered complete, timely or any other salient consideration. Information to register on SAM can be found at the web site, SAM.gov.

The contractor is responsible for entering the assessment results into the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE), specifically within the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) module. Contract award cannot be made to any offeror that is not fully compliant and whose assessment results are not properly recorded in the system of record.

List of Attachments:

Performance Work Statement

Solicitation

Required Information Sheet

Wage Determination

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search SAM.gov contract opportunities by keyword, agency, notice status, publication date, NAICS, set-aside, notice type and response deadline. Returns one page (default 20, max 100) with an opaque cursor for the next page. By default each hit is enriched with its full notice detail (NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, full description).

options.name: agency_ids
options.about: SAM.gov federal organization ids at any hierarchy level (100000000 = Dept of Defense, 300000188 = Dept of the Navy, 100006688 = Dept of Veterans Affairs). Matched as OR.

options.name: cursor
options.about: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Bound to the same filters and page_size; valid for 24 hours; then cursor_expired.

options.name: include_attachments
options.about: Also list each notice's attachments (one more upstream request per record). Requires include_details and page_size <= 50.

options.name: include_details
options.about: Fetch each hit's notice detail (one extra upstream request per record) so naics_codes, set_aside, place_of_performance and the full description are populated. false returns summary records with detail_level=summary.

options.name: naics_codes
options.about: NAICS codes or prefixes (2 to 6 digits). Matched as OR.

options.name: notice_types
options.about: Notice types (SAM.gov codes p,o,k,a,r,s,i,g,u,f,l). Empty = all.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Records per page. At most 50 when include_attachments is true.

options.name: published_from
options.about: Inclusive lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern calendar day) on the notice's latest publication/modification date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: published_to
options.about: Inclusive upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Must not be before published_from. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: query
options.about: Keyword query matched against title, solicitation number and description. Multi-word queries combine per query_mode (default: every word must match). Empty matches everything.

options.name: query_mode
options.about: How the words of query must match, as SAM.gov's own keyword search offers them (upstream qMode): all = every word (SAM.gov's default), any = at least one word, exact = the phrase as written.

options.name: response_deadline_from
options.about: Inclusive lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD) on the response deadline.

options.name: response_deadline_to
options.about: Inclusive upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD) on the response deadline.

options.name: set_asides
options.about: SAM.gov set-aside codes (SBA = total small business, 8A, HZC = HUBZone, SDVOSBC, WOSB, EDWOSB, ...). Matched as OR.

options.name: sort
options.about: sort

options.name: statuses
options.about: Notice status as SAM.gov indexes it. active = accepting responses / not yet archived; inactive = archived. Both = no status filter.

response.about: Search SAM.gov contract opportunities by keyword, agency, notice status, publication date, NAICS, set-aside, notice type and response deadline.
